definitions.retake: Next actual capture OR revolt of the same city within the window after a capture; captures lacking a complete follow-up horizon are excluded.
definitions.siegeCityMonth: At least one valid hostile contact row entering monthly City settlement. Capture frequency per city-month is NOT independent battle win probability.
definitions.units: Independent verified nearby unit IDs sampled at settlement, not collision calls; existing contact rows do not identify every historical attacker.
definitions.contactEnded: No valid contact is evidence of siege interruption only, not a verified military defeat or credited defensive victory.
definitions.cityDistribution: Cumulative City.captureCount includes captures and revolts; includes newly founded and archived cities observed by monthly settlement.
definitions.causality: Deterministic identical initial seeds; later RNG consumption and histories diverge. Comparisons are whole-rule experiments, not paired battle causal effects.
definitions.sample: 24 fixed seeds at 100 years; first 6 at 200 for baseline/BC-full; A/B/C/R/BCR screening only 4 seeds (first 2 at 200). No universal balance guarantee.
definitions.unification: Only canonical world-unification events. If none, first time/duration/refragmentation are not measurable; no political probabilities adjusted.
definitions.damage: Legacy diagnostic wall-damage delta omits capture-final hits when capture restores walls; not used as total damage or a conservation assertion.
